format: Research case study with analysis, methodology, findings, pipelines and Fabric execution evidence; no reproduction tutorial

questions.question: How are wind generation, solar generation and residual load associated with day-ahead electricity prices?
questions.method: Hourly exploration with within-month, hour-of-day and demand comparisons; association is not a causal effect.

questions.question: How do load-weighted and generation-weighted prices differ from time-average market prices?
questions.method: Compute ratios from underlying hourly weighted sums; distinguish wind, solar, load, negative-price exposure and denominator coverage.

questions.question: How would alternative tariff structures price the observed household consumption profile?
questions.status: Private API access confirmed; history coverage and pricing-regime comparison under investigation
questions.method: Use actual Tibber consumption and tariff periods, reconcile bills including fixed charges and taxes, compare identical coverage, separate unchanged-load counterfactuals from explicit feasible load-shifting scenarios. No tariff winner is assumed.
